subject.title: fix: A few bugs I found with proposed fixes
subject.author: esciara

diff_summary.note: Real, narrowly-scoped fix idea for #3828 items 2/3, but not safe to merge as its own diff (no --limit=0 once the status filter broadens, no direct regression coverage, duplicated stale-threshold literal, stale example doc). Closed 2026-07-10 claiming 'superseded by maintainer fixup / MR gt-wisp-b2ss' -- confirmed false via git log --all -S; no such fixup was ever committed to gastownhall/gastown main. Not merged, not reopened. Superseded for real by replacement PR #4726.

action_plan.summary: PR #4059 (esciara) proposed valid fixes for two of #3828's three bugs (dashboard misses hooked-status polecats; default stale_threshold too short at 5m). Five separate prior bead cycles across two PRs (#4059 and independent attempt #4038) over ~2 months all agreed this was a policy-allowed maintainer fixup, but every attempt failed to actually land it -- one gt done timeout left a branch unpushed, and both PRs were closed with false 'already merged'/'already on main' claims, independently disproven here via git log --all -S against every string those claims describe, checked against both gastownhall/gastown upstream/main and this fork's own diverged main. This pass ran a 5-reviewer independent pre-implementation review of an exact proposed patch, implemented it incorporating every requested change (including a deterministic hooked-vs-hooked precedence fix and a genuine revert-test), verified branch hygiene clean via gt pr-sheriff-check --merge-gate --base upstream/main, and opened https://github.com/gastownhall/gastown/pull/4726 from a personal fork with a Co-authored-by trailer preserving attribution to esciara. A second 5-reviewer independent post-implementation review confirmed the landed commit is correct (2 reviewers independently re-ran go build/vet/test and the revert-test from scratch), minimally scoped (exactly 5 files), and accurately described. PR #4726's CI is action_required pending a maintainer's approval (standard first-time-fork-contributor gate; this reviewer's account lacks the repo-admin rights to self-approve or label). No refinery/MQ route was used for the target GitHub PR.

repo_policy.note: PR #4726 could not be labeled by this reviewer's fork account (403: 'Must have admin rights to Repository' on gh pr edit --add-label and the equivalent REST call). It carries only the repo's automated status/needs-triage label. Recommend the overseer apply kind/bug, priority/p2, status/reviewing (or status/review-approved once CI is green).
no_verification_reasons: PR #4726's CI checks are action_required (queued, awaiting a maintainer's manual approval for a first-time fork PR) -- this is GitHub's standard security gate for external contributions, not a Sheriff-controllable state. Local go build/go vet/go test/gofmt were run directly against the exact commit as a substitute pre-CI verification.

Real fix idea for #3828 items 2/3, but missing --limit=0 once the filter broadens, no direct getAssignedIssuesMap regression test, a duplicated stale-threshold literal, and a stale docs/examples/town-settings.example.json entry.

research_legs.lens: Full bd-side dispatch history for this PR
research_legs.summary: bd search 4059: 6 beads -- hq-g1eh (guzzle's gt done timeout escalation, closed stale Aug 2026), gt-sc-8b0135da9e (sling-context), gt-kw53 (raider, review-only, correctly deferred and filed hq-2s040), gt-pr-4059-sheriff-review (this bead), gt-pr-sheriff-4059-resheriff (minuteman, closed 'Merged in gt-wisp-1lj'), gt-pr-sheriff-4059 (scavenger, closed 'Merged in gt-wisp-b2ss'). The referenced MR/wisp beads (gt-wisp-b2ss, gt-wisp-1lj, hq-2s040) are all expired/unresolvable via bd show.

guzzle's escalation: branch polecat/guzzle/gt-pr-sheriff-4059-clean, 1 commit ahead (44d9dfe8), gt done --target main timed out after 300s printing 'Resuming gt done from checkpoint', remote branch never pushed, bead left in_progress. Closed in August as environmentally stale/unreproducible -- not evidence the fix landed by another path.

research_legs.lens: Direct verification against upstream/main: config default
research_legs.summary: git show upstream/main:internal/config/types.go | grep StaleThreshold: -> "5m" (unchanged). The claimed fix is not present.
git show upstream/main:internal/web/fetcher.go, getAssignedIssuesMap: queries only --status=in_progress, no --limit=0, no hooked, no precedence logic. The claimed fix is not present.

research_legs.lens: Full-history search for the claimed fix, three independent strings
research_legs.summary: git log upstream/main --all -S for 'TestGetAssignedIssuesMapIncludesHookedWork', 'TestGetAssignedIssuesMapIncludesAssignedStatuses' (the string from PR #4038's own false claim), and 'in_progress,hooked' in internal/web/fetcher.go: zero hits on all three, across every branch reachable from upstream/main.

research_legs.lens: Ruling out a wrong-ref false negative
research_legs.summary: Same absence independently re-confirmed against this fork's own diverged main (origin/main, 265+ commits ahead of upstream) via direct file read of HEAD:internal/web/fetcher.go -- the fix is not present there either, so R07's negative result is not an artifact of checking the wrong repository.

research_legs.lens: Source issue #3828 current state and scope
research_legs.summary: gh issue view 3828: OPEN, kind/bug, priority/p2. Three items: (1) tmux socket scoping -- confirmed already independently fixed on upstream/main via tmuxSocket/runTmuxCmd presence; (2) getAssignedIssuesMap misses hooked; (3) stale_threshold default too short. PR #4059's own commit message already correctly scoped itself to items 2/3 only, matching this review's scope.

gh pr view 4038: CLOSED, mergedAt=null, same fix design (hooked inclusion, --limit=0) proposed independently by an automated contributor (wyf027/Hermes bot) and reviewed via 5 of its own PR-Sheriff-style comments. Final comment falsely claims 'origin/main already contained a cleaner version' -- contradicted by R07.
gh pr view 4059 --json commits: esciara's real commit-author email is emmanuel.sciara@gmail.com (name 'capable' / Emmanuel Sciara). Used verbatim in the replacement commit's Co-authored-by trailer.

research_legs.lens: bd CLI multi-status filter and --limit=0 behavior
research_legs.summary: Confirmed locally: bd list --status=in_progress,hooked --json returns issues from both statuses with a status field; bd list --help documents --limit 0 as 'unlimited' (default 50), not zero results.

research_legs.lens: Fork/push access for opening a replacement PR
research_legs.summary: gh repo view jamelt/gastown: isFork=true, parent=gastownhall/gastown. gh auth status: logged in as jamelt with repo scope. Sufficient to push a branch and open a PR; insufficient (confirmed via 403s later) to label, approve CI, or merge on the upstream repo -- as expected for a non-collaborator fork account.
gt pr-sheriff-check --base upstream/main --json: ahead=1, behind=0, severity=clean, merge_path_allowed=true. Rules out the PR #4238/#4257-style contamination failure mode.

research_legs.lens: Downstream consumers of the changed function/struct
research_legs.summary: grep -n assignedIssue internal/web/fetcher.go on upstream/main: the only caller (FetchWorkers) reads solely .ID/.Title from the map. Adding a Status field for internal precedence logic cannot leak into WorkerRow or calculateWorkerWorkStatus -- confirmed both before implementing and again by two independent post-implementation reviewers.

pre_implementation_reviews.summary: Sound overall; required verifying bd version compatibility for the comma-separated status filter (done, confirmed against installed bd), updating the getAssignedIssuesMap doc comment to mention hooked, documenting Status as internal-only, and updating types_test.go's message string alongside its literal.

Confirmed bd list --limit=0 means unlimited and --status accepts a comma list against a live bd binary. Found a real determinism gap: two hooked issues for the same assignee were not deterministically resolved (last-write-wins by array order). Required an explicit first-seen-wins fix, applied.

Confirmed the mirrored-literal-plus-doc-comment pattern already used for every sibling WorkerStatusConfig field in this exact file; the proposed patch introduces no new abstraction and stays within #3828 items 2/3. No bandaids or shims.

Confirmed the planned test would build-fail or assertion-fail against unmodified code, so it's not tautological. Required attaching genuine revert-test evidence (run the new test against the pre-fix tree and show it fail) rather than accepting a single green run as sufficient.

Confirmed kind/bug labeling means no human/feature-approval gate applies; confirmed esciara's real commit email for attribution; confirmed a normal external PR (not gastown's internal refinery/MQ) is the correct mechanism; confirmed the branch-hygiene gate is required and correctly scoped to --base upstream/main given the fork's known divergence. Required running gt pr-sheriff-check --merge-gate --base upstream/main and recording its output, and recommended flagging the false 'superseded'/'already fixed' claims already on GitHub for correction.

post_implementation_reviews.summary: Independently ran go build ./... (pass), go vet ./internal/config ./internal/web (pass), go test ./internal/config ./internal/web -count=1 (pass) directly against commit cb7829a00. Hand-traced the precedence logic through hooked-then-in_progress, in_progress-then-hooked, and two-hooked cases -- all correct. Confirmed assignedIssue.Status does not leak to any other caller.

git show --stat confirms exactly the 5 intended files, no dead code, no debug prints. Status field confirmed necessary (used immediately for precedence) and documented as internal-only. Commit message confirmed accurate, including the false-prior-claims note. Single clean commit directly off the merge-base.

Confirmed PR #4726 is OPEN, not draft, targets main, MERGEABLE (mergeStateStatus UNSTABLE pending CI). Confirmed the false 'superseded' comment exists verbatim on PR #4059. PR body confirmed accurate and non-misleading. Required: wait for CI to actually run/go green before treating this as merge-ready -- CI is action_required, not yet executed.

Independently reproduced the revert-test from scratch in a throwaway git worktree: pre-fix production code + new tests genuinely FAIL (concrete assertion mismatches, not build breaks); restoring the fix makes both genuinely PASS. Flagged one pre-existing, order-dependent flaky test in internal/config's full-package run (TestFillRuntimeDefaults) as unrelated to this change; independently re-confirmed it passes in isolation both by that reviewer and separately by this bead's own follow-up check.

Confirmed the Co-authored-by trailer is present and correctly formatted for GitHub co-author credit. Confirmed no contributor-change request was made; a maintainer fixup was used instead, consistent with skill.md. Confirmed opening a plain external PR (not refinery/MQ) is policy-correct. Recommended the overseer post corrective comments on #4059 and #4038 linking #4726, since skill.md's 'no GitHub comments from Sheriff' rule governs routine output, not indefinitely uncorrected false public claims.
